promise: Layer 3: users chain agents in visual workflows via multi-agent orchestration in the node editor.
gap: The graph, the node type, chaining and the SSE run loop all exist, but an agent node cannot actually run: (a) the config form writes config.prompt while the handler reads config.get('prompt_template') (builtin.py:166-169), so the user's prompt is dropped and every node falls back to the bare '{context}' template; (b) NodeEditorPanel.tsx:389 POSTs {spec, mode} only - no api_key, no provider - and the sidecar has no credential store (config.py:163-166 is a per-request ContextVar; the VYSTED_<PROV>_API_KEY env read named in builtin.py:158 exists nowhere in the code), so invoke_agent gets api_key=None against an 'anthropic'/'openai' default provider, and builtin.py:200-207 converts the resulting LLMErrorEvent into the string '(no provider key configured)' returned as a SUCCESSFUL node output.

promise: Example workflow: AI Researcher pulls a thesis, AI Strategy Critic critiques it, and if score > 7 it alerts via Telegram, otherwise logs to a journal.
evidence: Chain + condition: src/modules/node-editor/node-registry.ts:110-133 (ai.agent_invoke, logic.branch, logic.compare), sidecar/services/workflow_nodes/builtin.py:222+ (logic_branch with mode 'gt'). gap: The researcher -> critic -> score-threshold half of the example is buildable (subject to the INT-BP-95 blockers). The alerting half is not: there is no Telegram, webhook or any other out-of-app notification node - only a desktop notification that requires the app to be open and awake - and no journal/notes output node, so the 'otherwise logs to a journal' branch has nowhere to write but action.log's run transcript.
